before.description: With this gentle, waterless cleansing milk, you can effectively cleanse, refresh, and soothe your face and neck without stripping your skin of important oils. Made with Organic Damask Rose Water and Oil, this product has the added benefits of pore-tightening, skin irritation relief, and protection against cell damage. Simply pump onto a cotton wipe or pad, massage, and wipe away for convenient and effective facial cleansing that can be done anytime and anywhere. Cleanse gently, then follow with our Rose Water Spray to calm and tone. Perfect for sensitive skin or minimalist routines. Directions for use: Use a cotton wipe or pad to clean the face and eyes in the morning and evening. No rinse is necessary. Suitable for all skin types and gentle enough for daily use.
